character: 35 km downhill, 100+ km cross-country. Cross-country paradise near Swiss border.
name: Les Rousses
description: 50km of pistes, 14 lifts, on the Swiss border in the Jura. Known primarily as a cross-country destination (100km+ Nordic trails). The resort village is on the edge of a lake. Peaceful, forested, excellent value. Geneva 50 min.
